text:
Alex: Heads-up — I'll be in Lisbon next Tue–Thu and need dinner recs near Baixa / Cais do Sodré. Prefer outdoor seating, veg-friendly options, budget ~€25–40. Any faves? 🍷
Marie: @Alex If you want casual and lots of small plates, Time Out Market is easy (touristy but lots of options). Outdoor seating along the river in calmer spots.
Carlos: Skip the busiest stalls — for a proper local vibe try Taberna da Rua das Flores (tiny, no reservations). Best to go early or put your name down.
Joel: For seafood, Sea Me is fun — modern place, decent outdoor tables on the street. Expect to splurge a bit.
Sarah: If you want fully veg/vegan, Ao 26 — Vegan Food Project in Chiado is excellent and within a 15–20 min walk from Cais do Sodré. Cozy patio.
Priya: Also love Ponto Final (across the river) for sunset views — you take the short ferry from Cais do Sodré and walk up. Rustic, great for groups.
Marie: For reservations try TheFork app — lots of places list discounts there.
Alex: Poll — vibe for Tues: 1) Tapas/small plates 🍷 2) Modern Portuguese 🇵🇹 3) Vegan/plant-forward 🥬 — reply with emoji and I’ll book accordingly.
Carlos: 🍷

travel-bot: FYI flights look good, your return is unchanged. Also Lisbon dinner typically starts late — aim to book 20:00+ if you want a full experience.
Alex: Great — leaning tapas (thanks @Carlos) + one veg place as backup. Any quick dessert recs? Pastéis de Belém or a spot for a great ginjinha?
Carlos: Pastéis de Belém is the classic — get there earlier in the day though. For ginjinha try A Ginjinha (near Rossio). Tiny bar, standing room only.
Sarah: If you need accessibility or quieter spots, DM me and I’ll share a couple of off-grid cafes I found last year.
Alex: Awesome, thanks all. I’ll book for 20:15 on Tuesday and post details here. :tada:
